Title: Verify new customer registration with valid details
Preconditions: Browser open on https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/; user is not logged in
Steps: Navigate to Register page via header or /auth/register | Enter First name | Enter Last name | Select Date of Birth | Select Country | Enter Postal code | Enter House number | Verify Street City and State auto-populate | Enter Phone | Enter Email address | Enter Password meeting all rules | Click Register
TestData: firstName=Morgan; lastName=Reed; dob=1990-06-15; country=United States of America (the); postalCode=33101; houseNumber=42; phone=5550102001; email=unique via registrationFactory pattern; password=REGISTRATION_PASSWORD from local .env
ExpectedResult: User is redirected to /auth/login; success message or confirmation is displayed; registered email is not shown in an error state; no field-level validation errors remain on the form
ActualResult: Redirected to /auth/login after register; no validation errors on form; aligns with auth-register.spec.js @smoke

Title: Verify product search returns no results for non-matching keyword
Preconditions: Browser open on https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/; user is not required to be logged in
Steps: Navigate to home or products page | Locate Search field in filter sidebar | Enter a keyword that does not match any product | Submit search or wait for results
ExpectedResult: Product grid shows zero matching products or an explicit no-results message; no server error or blank page is displayed; search field retains entered keyword
ActualResult: 0 products found message displayed; zero product links; matches search-no-results.spec.js @regression
